name: Axial Strike
description: Strike along the central axis of the foe so that his whole stance gives way at once.

name: Median Wave
description: Send a wave of perfect mean through the field that turns each surge to an equal calm.

name: Anchoring Calm
description: Anchor an ally in a deep calm that eases the pain of his hurts and speeds their closing.

name: Restful Aegis
description: Spread an aegis of perfect rest over the user and allies against heavy blows.

name: Worldburden
description: Bring the whole weight of the foe's deeds to bear on him through every guard and press him still.

name: Origin Stillness
description: Draw the strain of a whole battle into the body and give it back to the wounded as health.

name: Balance Flash
description: Flash across the field along the line of least force and cancel a technique on the way.

name: Threshold Rinse
description: Wash all near allies clean of poison and curse and ward them while they recover.

name: Median Edict
description: The school's ruling move that decrees one median over the field with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Axis Verdict
description: The school's judging move that sets the axis through the foe with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Parity Rite
description: The school's rite that cancels hostile force and lifts allies to one level with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Equilibrium Cataclysm
description: Drive every force on a wide field to a single ruinous level at the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Equal Poise
description: Make one chosen happening and its opposite equal so that it simply does not occur; each use is a consequence event.

name: Axial Calm
description: Hold a deep calm at the axis of the field that presses foes down and shelters the user.

name: Deep Parity
description: Set a deep parity under the whole field that voids the techniques of every foe caught in it.

name: Rooted Accord
description: Root the allies in one accord of strength that shields each and shares the load of all.

name: Mending Poise
description: Pour a mending poise into an ally that closes his wounds and clears the taint from them.

name: Origin Rest
description: Take in the raging force round an ally and give back deep rest in its place.

name: Pole Strike
description: Strike from the pole of the axis with a force that passes every guard and ward.

name: Equal Passage
description: Pass through the line where two great forces cancel and come out unharmed on the far side.

name: Stillness Descends
description: Let a vast stillness settle on the field so that nothing in it can rise or move.

name: Equity Decree
description: The school's decree that brings every force in the field to equity with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Poise Edict
description: The school's gentle edict that voids hostile force and mends the allies with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Axis Rite
description: The school's rite that drives the axis through one foe with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: World Parity
description: Bring a whole land to parity in one ruinous act at the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Apex Stillness
description: Still all motion on a vast field at the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Unmake Imbalance
description: End every technique that lives by imbalance within sight as if it were never loosed; each use is a consequence event.

name: Primal Quiescence
description: Set one wounded person or place back to its state before the harm; each use is a consequence event.
